next_question.rationale: I expect a large share of the drop from "requested a consultation" to "paid and confirmed" to be concentrated on online (app/web) requests rather than clinic visits. Many abandonments are "abandoned by system" and app/technical and doctor-related voc themes point to matching/timeouts or platform failures affecting online routing; if online requests convert materially worse and they represent most requests, engineering or routing fixes there would recover a large share of the 87,511 lost here.
